parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile", messages: [{role: "system", content: "You are a research agent. Given a research topic and subtasks, identify 3-5 relevant candidate options (models, tools, or approaches) with brief supporting details for each. Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this format: {\"models\": [{\"name\": \"...\", \"details\": \"...\"}]}"}, {role: "user", content: "Research topic and subtasks: " + $json.choices[0].message.content}]}) }}

={"model": "llama-3.3-70b-versatile", "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are a research planning agent. Given a research question, break it into 4-6 clear research subtasks. Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this exact format, no extra text: {\"topic\": \"...\", \"subtasks\": [\"...\", \"...\"]}"}, {"role": "user", "content": "{{ $json.body.question }}"}]}

={{ JSON.stringify({model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile", messages: [{role: "system", content: "You are a technical analysis agent. Given a research topic and subtasks, analyze technical specifications: parameters, context length, VRAM/hardware requirements, quantization support, and inference frameworks. Focus on modern open-source LLMs like Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek. Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this format: {\"technical_comparison\": [{\"model\": \"...\", \"parameters\": \"...\", \"context_length\": \"...\", \"vram_requirement\": \"...\", \"frameworks\": \"...\"}]}"}, {role: "user", content: "Research topic and subtasks: " + $json.choices[0].message.content}]}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile", messages: [{role: "system", content: "You are a cost and performance analysis agent. Given a research topic and subtasks about LLMs, analyze what hardware profile each model realistically fits (e.g. 8GB VRAM, 16GB VRAM, CPU-only), expected inference speed, and quantization tradeoffs. Focus on modern open-source LLMs like Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek. Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this format: {\"recommendations\": [{\"model\": \"...\", \"hardware_fit\": \"...\", \"reasoning\": \"...\"}]}"}, {role: "user", content: "Research topic and subtasks: " + $json.choices[0].message.content}]}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile", messages: [{role: "system", content: "You are a fact-checking agent. You will receive findings from three research agents: a general researcher, a technical analyst, and a cost/performance analyst. Compare their claims for consistency. For each model mentioned, note whether the agents agree or conflict on key facts. Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this format: {\"verified_findings\": [{\"model\": \"...\", \"agreement_status\": \"...\", \"notes\": \"...\"}]}"}, {role: "user", content: "Research findings: " + $input.all().map(item => item.json.choices[0].message.content).join("\n\n")}]}) }}
